items.install: case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in amd64) T=node-v24.22.1-linux-x64.tar.xz S=6c172a9ab6718f7b801fb5a7bd486af2ee5e32758086a04b84fcce2aa77095e6 ;; arm64) T=node-v24.22.1-linux-arm64.tar.xz S=dbabf7a1cbf947e6059ffad2c27b80041db97dea1e553b62afdee7f13fca336e ;; *) echo "node+pnpm: no pinned Node tarball for architecture $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac && curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 300 --retry 2 --retry-delay 3 --retry-all-errors "https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.1/$T" -o "/tmp/$T" && echo "$S  /tmp/$T" | sha256sum -c - && rm -rf /opt/tools/node.new && mkdir -p /opt/tools/node.new && tar -xf "/tmp/$T" -C /opt/tools/node.new --strip-components=1 && rm -f "/tmp/$T" && rm -rf /opt/tools/node && mv /opt/tools/node.new /opt/tools/node && /opt/tools/node/bin/npm install -g pnpm@11.28.8
items.name: node+pnpm
items.rationale: Node.js LTS + pnpm from the ccpraxis recipe (plugins/backpack/recipes/node-pnpm.json): the sandbox image ships no Node since 2026-10-30, so a project that builds with Node declares it here. Exact pins chosen by the version rule (latest LTS, at least 7 days old, never EOL; re-pin with bp-pin.pl resolve), and each Node tarball is checked against its pinned sha256. pnpm stays on its maintained 11.x line because pnpm 12 installs its native binary from an install script, which this container disables. Installed under /opt/tools/node, whose bin directory is on the image PATH, so tools from npm install -g land on PATH as well. For an npm-only project, drop the pnpm install step and its verify clause.
